items.subject: Claude 3.7 Sonnet

items.sourceExcerpt: Second, when using Claude 3.7 Sonnet through the API, users can also control the budget for thinking: you can tell Claude to think for no more than N tokens, for any value of N up to its output limit of 128K tokens.

items.subject: Claude 3.7 Sonnet

items.subject: Transport layer
items.objectOrValue: the communication mechanisms and channels that enable data exchange between clients and servers
items.textZh: Transport layer 定义实现客户端与服务器之间数据交换的通信机制和通道。
items.sourceExcerpt: * **Transport layer**: Defines the communication mechanisms and channels that enable data exchange between clients and servers, including transport-specific connection establishment, message framing, and authorization.

items.subject: Data layer
items.objectOrValue: the JSON-RPC based protocol for client-server communication
items.textZh: Data layer 定义基于 JSON-RPC 的客户端-服务器通信协议。
items.sourceExcerpt: * **Data layer**: Defines the JSON-RPC based protocol for client-server communication, including capability and version discovery, and core primitives, such as tools, resources, prompts and notifications.
